items.source: Entity callback method invoked before an aggregate root is deleted. Can return either the same or a modified instance of the aggregate and can modify MutableAggregateChange contents. This method is called after converting the aggregate to MutableAggregateChange. Changes to the aggregate are not taken into account for deleting. Only transient fields of the entity should be changed in this callback.
items.translation: 在删除聚合根之前调用实体回调方法。可以返回相同的或修改后的聚合实例，并可以修改 MutableAggregateChange 的内容。此方法在将 aggregate 转换为 MutableAggregateChange 之后被调用。对聚合的更改不会用于删除操作。在此回调中，仅应修改实体的瞬态字段。

items.source: An EntityCallback that gets invoked before an entity is deleted. This callback gets only invoked if the method deleting the aggregate received an instance of that aggregate as an argument. Methods deleting entities by id or without any parameter don't invoke this callback.
items.translation: 一个在删除实体之前被调用的EntityCallback。如果删除聚合的方法接收了该聚合的实例作为参数，才会调用此回调。通过 ID 删除实体或无参数的删除方法不会触发此回调。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked before an aggregate root is deleted.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在聚合根被删除之前被调用。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可以用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
